text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Candles are good, and party poppers are...
Ah, grab 5 packs from that shelf over there!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet is in charge of organizing the Ritto Dorm's
Christmas party this year. I was helping her with the shopping, but...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Is something wrong?
Yeah... hmm... space for the tree, huh...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...A symmetrical layout really does look better after all!
Move the shelf and try it one more time!
Yep, thanks!"
choice_data_list: Shouldn't you rest for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: No way. What if your preparations get delayed?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, we don't have time to chit-chat!
On to the next counter!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Scarlet. I'm mostly finished up here.
If you need a hand, don't hesitate to let me know."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'm here too! ♪
I finished prepping Miho and had some free time, so I'll help out.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...I'm sorry,
it's all because I was too slow...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "That's not true. It's just that I arrived earlier than expected."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for leaving it all to you.
Here, let me see the shopping list.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, for the remaining items, we'd best check the shopping district.
The shops that assist the student council should do nicely.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Oh, do you need tree ornaments too?
Miho has about ten or so to spare.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Could you share whatever else you have at Miho?
It would save us time and keep costs down.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
And so, would it be okay
to proceed like that?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
(I see, having them share some is an option too...
Ugh, I was being so narrow-minded...!)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Um... thank you so very much!
...Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, looks like we got everything.
Did we forget to buy anything?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Yes! This will do just fine—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: “—Huh...? Where's the Christmas wreath...?”

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Oh right! It was sold out, so I was gonna buy it later...
Ugh, jeez! What an idiot I am!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...However, we should head back soon,
or we won't finish our preparations in time."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I want to search until the very last second!
Because it's absolutely necessary...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The girls in the Ritto dorm are looking forward to it too.
They said, "Let's take lots of cute pictures
with the wreath in the background!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: A wreath is essential for a photo spot! So... I'm going to search for one!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Please! I want the decorations to turn out
perfect, just like we all planned together!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Then let us split up and search.
We must find it as quickly as possible."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Air Groove-senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay! Going out to look for one is fine,
but making one by hand is an option too.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I see...! If we make it by hand, we're guaranteed to get one...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: There's stuff here that Miho could use too, so feel free to take it with you♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...In that case, I wonder which one is better.
Hey, Trainer, what do you think?"
choice_data_list: We should all go buy it together
I feel like handmade would be more reliable...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'd like that too.
Let's split up and look around!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Air Groove-senpai told me
they found the wreath!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Did you hear that too, Scarlett-chan?
Let's head back first and get ready!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Is it really okay
for you to help me decorate...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I'll get it done flawlessly
and surprise Air Groove-chan.
choice_data_list: If it's Scarlet, she can pull it off!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Of course! I'll put together a party that'll make everyone say it's the best!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The next day. Daiwa Scarlet came first thing in the morning and happily told me that the party was a huge success!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You're right. I'm good at delicate, detailed work,
so I'll make it myself...!
choice_data_list: If it's you, you'll pull it off!
I know you can pull it off!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Of course! I'll put together a party that'll make everyone say, "This is the best!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Together with the ingredients Laurel-san gave me...
Yeah, I can make it with this!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Focus on the wreath.
Don't worry about the other tasks.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Looking forward to it!
I'll make it turn out even prettier
than the ones sold in stores!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The next day. Daiwa Scarlet showed me her Christmas wreath.
It looks like the party was a huge success, too!
